thanks for your enquiry. As a guide price for interior walls we charge from €9 per m² of wall area, materials included. Only our quote after a visit is binding.

Kind regards
Conor Brennan
Brennan & Doyle Painting Ltd

<m12.2026-11-18@mailbox.example>.subject: Re: Can you paint over mould in the bathroom?
<m12.2026-11-18@mailbox.example>.body:
Hi Tomasz,

thanks for your enquiry. We don't paint over mould, because it comes back. We check the cause on site first and only paint once it has been fixed. For damp damage we recommend a surveyor.

We're glad to arrange a visit, which is free within 30 km.

Kind regards
Conor Brennan
Brennan & Doyle Painting Ltd
Unit 4, Millbrook Business Park, Kilcarra, Co. Wicklow
Phone 0404 55 127

<m13.2026-11-19@postbox.example>.subject: Re: Child's bedroom: strip wallpaper and repaint
<m13.2026-11-19@postbox.example>.body:
Hi Niamh,

thanks for your enquiry. We strip old wallpaper from €6 per m². Then we fill and prime the walls so the new paint lasts.

As standard we use low-emission water-based paints with the EU Ecolabel. Silicate or lime paints are possible on request. We make a binding quote after a free visit.

Kind regards
Conor Brennan
Brennan & Doyle Painting Ltd
Unit 4, Millbrook Business Park, Kilcarra, Co. Wicklow
Phone 0404 55 127

<m14.2026-11-19@webpost.example>.subject: Re: Repainting a rented flat in Rossbeg
<m14.2026-11-19@webpost.example>.body:
Hi Ciaran,

thanks for your enquiry. We work in Kilcarra and within 30 km of it. Beyond that we charge a travel fee of €45 per day. Rossbeg is about 45 km away, so it is outside, but we are still happy to take the job.

Our lead time is currently 3 to 4 weeks, which works well for the end of January.

Kind regards
Conor Brennan
Brennan & Doyle Painting Ltd
Unit 4, Millbrook Business Park, Kilcarra, Co. Wicklow
Phone 0404 55 127

<m15.2026-11-20@walsh-partners.example>.subject: Re: Quote for painting our office floor
<m15.2026-11-20@walsh-partners.example>.body:
Dear Dr Walsh,

thanks for your enquiry. We invoice after the final walk-through, payable within 14 days. For jobs over €5,000 we agree a deposit of 30%.

For a binding quote we would like to see the office floor first. You get the quote within 5 working days of the visit. Our lead time is currently 3 to 4 weeks, so a start in February is no problem.

Kind regards
Conor Brennan
Brennan & Doyle Painting Ltd
Unit 4, Millbrook Business Park, Kilcarra, Co. Wicklow
Phone 0404 55 127
